use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering::SeqCst};
use std::sync::{Arc, Barrier, Mutex};
static DROPS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static SUM: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static LIVE: Mutex<Vec<usize>> = Mutex::new(Vec::new());
static ALLOCS: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static FREES: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
unsafe extern "C" {
    fn malloc(n: usize) -> *mut u8;
    fn free(p: *mut u8);
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn arc_test_malloc(n: usize) -> *mut u8 {
    // SAFETY: libc malloc accepts any size; null is checked before use.
    let p = unsafe { malloc(n) };
    assert!(!p.is_null());
    LIVE.lock().unwrap().push(p as usize);
    ALLOCS.fetch_add(1, SeqCst);
    p
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn arc_test_free(p: *mut u8) {
    let mut live = LIVE.lock().unwrap();
    let at = live
        .iter()
        .position(|&x| x == p as usize)
        .expect("double or invalid free");
    live.swap_remove(at);
    FREES.fetch_add(1, SeqCst);
    // SAFETY: the live set proves this is a unique, still-live libc allocation.
    unsafe {
        free(p);
    }
}
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
extern "C" fn arc_test_dropped(sum: usize) {
    SUM.store(sum, SeqCst);
    DROPS.fetch_add(1, SeqCst);
}
// Each wrapper owns exactly one Flux handle. No host reads its representation.
// Sending a wrapper transfers ownership; all FFI borrows end before its release.
struct Strong(*mut u8);
struct Weak(*mut u8);
// SAFETY: transferring the wrapper transfers its one strong owner; Payload
// is Send + Sync and Flux atomically manages its shared allocation.
unsafe impl Send for Strong {}
// SAFETY: the wrapper transfers one weak owner, which pins its atomic header.
unsafe impl Send for Weak {}
impl Strong {
    fn new() -> Self {
        // SAFETY: audited C scalar ABI; the result owns a fresh strong wrapper.
        Self(unsafe { arc_create() })
    }
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: self pins a live wrapper for this borrow; result is a new owner.
        Self(unsafe { arc_clone(self.0) })
    }
    fn weak(&self) -> Weak {
        // SAFETY: self pins the strong wrapper until downgrade returns.
        Weak(unsafe { arc_downgrade(self.0) })
    }
    fn write_release(self, slot: usize) {
        let p = self.0;
        std::mem::forget(self);
        // SAFETY: ownership moved out of self once; the worker has its unique
        // slot in 0..8, and the Flux call consumes this wrapper exactly once.
        assert_eq!(unsafe { arc_write_release(p, slot) }, 1);
    }
}
impl Drop for Strong {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: Drop consumes the uniquely owned live wrapper exactly once.
        assert_eq!(unsafe { arc_release(self.0) }, 1);
    }
}
impl Weak {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        // SAFETY: self pins a live wrapper for this borrow; result is a new owner.
        Self(unsafe { weak_clone(self.0) })
    }
    fn upgrade(&self) -> Option<Strong> {
        // SAFETY: self pins the weak wrapper/header throughout this borrow.
        let p = unsafe { weak_upgrade(self.0) };
        if p.is_null() { None } else { Some(Strong(p)) }
    }
}
impl Drop for Weak {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // SAFETY: Drop consumes the uniquely owned live wrapper exactly once.
        assert_eq!(unsafe { weak_release(self.0) }, 1);
    }
}
fn balanced() {
    assert!(LIVE.lock().unwrap().is_empty());
    assert_eq!(ALLOCS.load(SeqCst), FREES.load(SeqCst));
}
fn main() {
    // SAFETY: audited no-argument C scalar function, with no preconditions.
    assert_eq!(unsafe { empty_weak_control() }, 1);
    assert_eq!(ALLOCS.load(SeqCst), 0);
    let a = Strong::new();
    let w = a.weak();
    let upgraded = w.upgrade().unwrap();
    drop(a);
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(SeqCst), 0);
    drop(upgraded);
    assert_eq!(DROPS.load(SeqCst), 1);
    assert!(w.upgrade().is_none());
    drop(w);
    balanced();
    for _ in 0..40 {
        let start = DROPS.load(SeqCst);
        let a = Strong::new();
        let weak = a.weak();
        let barrier = Arc::new(Barrier::new(9));
        let mut threads = Vec::new();
        for slot in 0..8 {
            let a = a.clone();
            let barrier = barrier.clone();
            threads.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {
                barrier.wait();
                for _ in 0..400 {
                    let c = a.clone();
                    let w = c.weak();
                    drop(w.upgrade().unwrap());
                }
                a.write_release(slot);
            }));
        }
        drop(a);
        barrier.wait();
        for t in threads {
            t.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert_eq!(DROPS.load(SeqCst), start + 1);
        assert_eq!(SUM.load(SeqCst), 36); // last strong sees all eight plain writes
        assert!(weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert_eq!(LIVE.lock().unwrap().len(), 2); // header plus opaque weak wrapper
        drop(weak);
        balanced();

        // Race upgrade against last strong, retaining a distinct weak in each
        // worker. Successful upgrades pin the data until their own drop.
        let start = DROPS.load(SeqCst);
        let a = Strong::new();
        let weak = a.weak();
        let barrier = Arc::new(Barrier::new(5));
        let mut threads = Vec::new();
        for _ in 0..4 {
            let weak = weak.clone();
            let barrier = barrier.clone();
            threads.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {
                barrier.wait();
                for _ in 0..400 {
                    drop(weak.upgrade());
                }
            }));
        }
        barrier.wait();
        drop(a);
        for t in threads {
            t.join().unwrap();
        }
        assert!(weak.upgrade().is_none());
        assert_eq!(DROPS.load(SeqCst), start + 1);
        drop(weak);
        balanced();

        // Last explicit weak versus last strong; neither host wrapper aliases.
        let start = DROPS.load(SeqCst);
        let a = Strong::new();
        let weak = a.weak();
        let barrier = Arc::new(Barrier::new(2));
        let other = barrier.clone();
        let thread = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            other.wait();
            drop(weak);
        });
        barrier.wait();
        drop(a);
        thread.join().unwrap();
        assert_eq!(DROPS.load(SeqCst), start + 1);
        balanced();
    }
}
